newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Q1 net soars at Colombia's Corfinsura.
newsitem.headline: Q1 net soars at Colombia's Corfinsura.

text.p: The net profit of Colombia's Corfinsura SA, a financial arm of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, jumped by 790 percent in the first quarter compared to the same period last year, the company said in a statement.
It said the Q1 net totalled 44.6 billion pesos just over 5 billion pesos in first quarter of last year.

The financial group, which is a branch of Compania Suramericana de Seguros -- Colombia's largest insurer -- attributed most of the huge increase in its earnings to returns on its investment portfolio and a run-up in local stock valuations during the first three months of the year.
